methods.four_quadrant: Common threshold across signs; paper ++ is fit separately at its original threshold.
methods.triples: Median, 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 2000 pair-bootstrap medians. These intervals condition on this anchor sample and ignore dependencies from shared directions.
methods.sign_split: Within each pair, average over both semantic signs before taking the median over pairs. Difference is computed within pair before taking medians. Positive language/code sign is the projection of target minus English prompt directions.
